title: Kumsa Moroda
logline: A short remembrance of Kumsa Moroda, the Oromo leader of Nekemte, whose wisdom and courage still shape how a family speaks of home.
audience: Oromo family and friends in Ethiopia and the diaspora who want a short, shareable film about a name they honour.
intent: Feel pride and closeness to Oromo history; understand Kumsa Moroda as a leader of place, people, and memory—not only a name in a book.
style_block: warm grainy hand-painted look, soft highland light, muted greens and earth ochres, gentle film grain, no text in image, consistent character face

character.name: Kumsa Moroda
character.description: Oromo leader in his middle years, dignified bearing, dark beard lightly greying, wrapped in a patterned gabi, calm steady eyes, standing among Welega highland hills

music.caption: gentle instrumental underscore, soft plucked strings and warm pads, slow heartbeat rhythm, highland nostalgia, hopeful resolve, no vocals

cues.note: slight lift as leadership and people appear

shots.reason: Establish Welega / Nekemte highland place before we meet him.
shots.image_prompt: Wide highland hills of Welega Ethiopia at golden hour, paths toward a distant town, soft mist in valleys, warm light
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle camera push-in over the hills, soft mist drifting
shots.narration: Gaafa ganama, tulluuwwan Wallaggaa ni dammaqsu.
shots.narration_en: At dawn, the hills of Welega wake first.

shots.reason: Introduce Kumsa Moroda as the film's heart.
shots.image_prompt: Kumsa Moroda standing on a hillside wrapped in a patterned gabi, calm steady eyes, soft highland wind, warm light
shots.motion_prompt: he slowly turns his head toward the valley, camera holds gently
shots.narration_en: His name is Kumsa Moroda—leader of Nekemte.

shots.reason: Show leadership as care for people and land.
shots.image_prompt: Oromo leader walking among farmers on a highland path, baskets and fields, respectful gathering, soft daylight
shots.motion_prompt: slow tracking beside him as people greet him gently
shots.narration: Inni lafa qofa hin hogganu; ummata isaa waliin jira.
shots.narration_en: He did not lead land alone; he walked with his people.

shots.reason: Intimate detail—hands and gabi as inheritance motif.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of weathered hands adjusting a patterned gabi cloth, shallow depth of field, warm rim light
shots.motion_prompt: subtle handheld breath, fingers settle the cloth
shots.narration: Harka isaa seenaa qabata—dhaalaa fi abdii.
shots.narration_en: His hands hold history—inheritance and hope.

shots.reason: Council / gathering as wisdom and voice of community.
shots.image_prompt: evening gathering under a large tree, elders seated in a circle, Kumsa Moroda listening then speaking calmly, warm firelight edge
shots.motion_prompt: gentle push-in toward the circle, soft fire flicker
shots.narration: Yeroo marii, sagaleen isaa nagaafi of-eeggannoo qaba.
shots.narration_en: In council, his voice carried peace and careful strength.

shots.reason: Nekemte as living place tied to his name.
shots.image_prompt: historic highland town lanes of Nekemte at soft dusk, people walking home, warm windows, hills beyond
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan across the town toward the hills
shots.narration_en: Nekemte does not forget his name.

shots.image_prompt: young person listening to an elder tell a story beside a window, soft lamp light, quiet home interior, highland night outside
shots.motion_prompt: very slow drift toward their faces, intimate stillness
shots.narration: Ijoolleen keenya ammallee seenaa isaa dhagahu.
shots.narration_en: Our children still hear his story.

shots.reason: Close on pride and belonging for the audience.
shots.image_prompt: silhouette of Kumsa Moroda on a ridge at dusk, Welega hills behind him, warm afterglow sky
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back revealing the hills, he stands calmly
shots.narration: Maqaan isaa ammas karaa keenya irratti nu qajeelcha.
shots.narration_en: His name still guides us on the road home.

shots.reason: Final motif—cloth and land as living inheritance.
shots.image_prompt: folded patterned gabi on a wooden stool beside an open window looking onto green highland fields, quiet morning light
shots.motion_prompt: slow Ken Burns style drift across cloth toward the window view
